name: Fiesta y magdalenas
source:
We started a baking club.
Sounds harmless, right? 
It wasn’t.

What seemed like a cozy hobby turned into a trap set by the magical girl of fun and chaos. But something went wrong. 

A new kind of wizard was born:
Metz, the magical boy of time and cycles. 

[From [url=https://galletadev.itch.io/party-and-cupcake]itch.io[/url]]
